purpose: Teach: 外注/両社/差し支え/損ね/歯科医/部内/組立/伝票

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 外注、若い頃、批判的に見ていた。
lines.en: When I was young, I looked at outsourcing with suspicion.
lines.style: Reflective, measured. Light pause after the opening phrase. Speaking from long memory. Quiet authority—not harsh judgment, just honest recollection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。両社の信頼関係、長期で築いてきました。
lines.en: Yes. We've built that trust between our firms over a long time.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Steady, deliberate pace. Precise—each phrase weighted to show the care taken. Warm but formal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 差し支えのない範囲で、新しい挑戦、進めろ。
lines.en: So push forward with new challenges, within reason.
lines.style: Gentle permission, not order. A slight lean forward in the tone. Quiet conviction. The phrasing itself grants freedom.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。先輩を損ねないよう、配慮、続けます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep being thoughtful so as not to disappoint the people who came before.
lines.style: Earnest, careful. Not defensive, but attentive—showing he understands the responsibility. Steady eye-contact in his voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時から、社員の歯科医費、補助していた。
lines.en: Even from the beginning, we subsidized dental care for our staff.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Speaking as witness to something that mattered. Slight warmth under the surface—this was a choice, not an accident.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。部内の絆、強化しています。
lines.en: Yes. I'm working to strengthen the bonds within our department.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. Not boastful. Shows he has heard and is carrying forward. Deliberate, careful word choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 組立精神、伝統として残せ。
lines.en: Keep that spirit of assembly as a tradition.
lines.style: Final directive—not harsh, but weighted. Slight slowdown on the key words. Voice carries the gravity of what's being passed down.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。伝票も、紙文化、最後まで守ります。
lines.en: Yes. I'll protect the paper culture of our vouchers to the very end.
lines.style: Quiet, firm closing. A small smile audible—understands both the literal and what it represents. Respect for continuity without being frozen by it.
